sourceTitle: The Natural History of the Gent
description: "The Natural History of the Gent" by Albert Smith is a satirical social commentary written in the mid-19th century. This humorous exploration examines the characteristics and behaviors of a particular class of individuals in society referred to as "Gents," who are depicted as pretentious and lacking in genuine gentlemanly qualities.
